title: Concept: Monetary amount sent as a floating point number
description: An amount serialised as an unquoted decimal in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Binary floating point cannot hold every decimal, so the same amount can round a paisa away between the client and the ledger, and the difference is invisible in the response.
applicability: Deployments that render an amount serialised as an unquoted decimal into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Binary floating point cannot hold every decimal, so the same amount can round a paisa away between the client and the ledger, and the difference is invisible in the response.
